description: This file defines the 'UnitConversion' class in the Coocook schema, representing unit conversion data including conversion factors and relationships between units. It includes methods for reversing conversions.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::UnitConversion
classes.description: A class representing a unit conversion record, including conversion factors and relationships between units.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Reverses the unit conversion by swapping units and inverting the factor.
